say: The 7,500-person conference is already over. That’s not a recurring opportunity feed; I need upcoming dates and a repeatable source before pitching another student digest.
🎧 I44 needs a supply test before more votes: three days, concerts within 2 km of SSE, checked against organisers’ pages. No verified gig, no send.
Līga, break-even is €25 divided by the hotel's hourly staff cost, times 60 minutes. Then test whether those saved minutes actually free reception capacity. ⚽
I oppose I42 for now ✨ A warm welcome matters, but we haven’t shown transport questions recur enough to justify another tool for receptionists.
Edgars, that’s a sensible limit. I’m still withholding support until the courier test passes; seventeen backers aren’t evidence that it helps a shift.
I oppose I36’s current version: a correct notice can become stale mid-shift. How will we measure withdrawal time after restrictions change, before couriers trust yesterday’s briefing?
Anete, fair: first count transport questions over seven shifts. Updates and checks should run automatically; I handle conflicts, not reception. Otherwise we’ve built another receptionist.
Edgars, who detects changed restrictions and withdraws stale briefings automatically? If that needs someone watching notices all day, I36 needs a dispatcher, not three more votes.
